site.name: Hoy en Canarias
site.description: Discover events across the eight Canary Islands: concerts, markets, festivals, culture and nature.

footer.notice: Data comes from public sources. Always check the official source before you go.

common.error: The information could not be loaded.

search.title: Search events
search.voiceUnsupported: Your browser does not support voice search.
search.voiceDenied: Microphone access was denied. You can type your search instead.
search.voiceError: The voice could not be recognised. Try again or type.
search.voiceReview: Check the recognised text, then press Search.

home.heroTitle: What's on in the Canary Islands today
home.heroLead: Concerts, markets, festivals and nature across all eight islands, in one place and without signing up.
home.empty: No events are published yet. Check back soon.

map.lead: Upcoming events on the map of the islands. You can also browse them in the list.
map.located: Map centred on your location. Your position is not stored.
map.locateDenied: Your location could not be found. You can keep using the map and the list.
map.locateUnavailable: Your browser does not offer location.
map.noPoints: No events with a location in this area.
map.truncated: Only the first 1000 events in this area are shown. Zoom in to see more.
map.unavailable: The map is not available right now. The list below shows the same events.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Hoy en Canarias can be browsed without an account or sign-up. Here is what we process and what we do not.
privacy.noAccount: We do not ask for an account, email address or personal data to browse.
privacy.noLocation: Your location is used only if you tap “Use my location”, to centre the map. It is not stored or sent to our servers.
privacy.voice: Voice search is handled by your browser's speech recognition. We do not record or store audio.
privacy.noTracking: This version uses no tracking cookies and no third-party analytics.

about.title: About
about.body: Hoy en Canarias brings public events from the eight islands together in one place, with their date, venue and source.
about.sources: Each event shows where it came from. When something is unclear we leave it blank rather than guess.

error.title: Page not found
error.body: The link may have changed, or the event is no longer published.

share.title: Share
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address in the browser bar instead.

submit.title: Publish an event
submit.intro: Know an event that is not listed here? Tell us. We review it before publishing.
submit.privacy: We do not ask for your name or e-mail. Do not write contact details in the description: we remove them automatically.
submit.failed: It could not be sent right now. Please try again later.
submit.received: Thank you, we have received it.
submit.receivedBody: We review it before publishing. If it meets the conditions, it will appear in the listings.

errors.title: Write a title of 3 to 160 characters.
errors.startDate: Choose a date within the next year.
errors.url: The link must start with https:// or http://.

favorites.title: My favourites
favorites.intro: Saved only in this browser. You don't need an account and nothing is sent to a server.
favorites.empty: You have no favourites yet. Tap ♡ on any event to save it.
